claims.quote: When I say I want good growth in every postcode, that means every single postcode in Scotland as well.
claims.statement: Good growth should reach every postcode in Scotland.
The Prime Minister is offering Scotland devolution of DWP employment support, a localised model shaped by Holyrood.

claims.quote: the fact is around one in six young people here are not in education, employment or training.
claims.statement: Around one in six young people in Scotland are not in education, employment or training.

claims.quote: If you go to Edinburgh today, you’ll see around one in twenty shops lying empty.
claims.statement: Around one in twenty shops in Edinburgh are lying empty, against about one in five in Dundee.

claims.quote: A man in East Renfrewshire can live, as I understand, on average seven years longer than a man in Glasgow
claims.statement: A man in East Renfrewshire can on average live about seven years longer than a man in Glasgow.

claims.quote: Instead, we’ve ended up with the situation where Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is itself one of the most centralised nations in Europe.
claims.statement: Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is one of the most centralised nations in Europe.

claims.quote: I won’t have a country where we get comfortable with the idea of kids in their 20s just being there on benefits.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister will not accept young people in their 20s being left on benefits.

claims.quote: I want to work with the First Minister to deliver it.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants to work with the First Minister to deliver good growth in every postcode.

claims.quote: I want to push economic power out into the regions of Scotland.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants to push economic power out into the regions of Scotland.
Growth will not wait, and Scotland could lose out if the government does not move now.

claims.quote: in a couple of weeks, the National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales
claims.statement: The National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales in a couple of weeks.

facts.quote: When I walked into Downing Street in July, I said I wanted to do politics differently.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister entered Downing Street in July and said he wanted to do politics differently.

facts.quote: I was in Scotland for the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in the summer
facts.statement: The Prime Minister attended the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in the summer.

facts.quote: I left Westminster in 2017 to become the first Mayor of Greater Manchester
facts.statement: The Prime Minister left Westminster in 2017 to become the first Mayor of Greater Manchester.

facts.quote: I visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse
facts.statement: The Prime Minister visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse with the Greater Manchester Violence Reduction Unit in August 2023.

facts.quote: I took everything I heard that day from Easterhouse and I took it back to Greater Manchester and I used it to pioneer what we called the Live Well model in Greater Manchester.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister took lessons from Easterhouse back to Greater Manchester and pioneered the Live Well model there.

facts.quote: So I was determined that the buses on the roads of Greater Manchester today were built by Alexander Dennis in Falkirk.
facts.statement: Greater Manchester buses were built by Alexander Dennis in Falkirk after the Prime Minister put buses under public control there.

facts.quote: It is great that the Scottish government has this week agreed to match the UK government’s £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges
facts.statement: The Scottish government agreed this week to match the UK government's £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges, one in the east and one in the west.

facts.quote: has seen companies like Chemify turn groundbreaking research into real manufacturing jobs in Glasgow.
facts.statement: Chemify has turned groundbreaking research into real manufacturing jobs in Glasgow.

facts.quote: It’s also why I am working on a new deal for food and farming at the EU-UK Summit on the 20th of November.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister is working on a new deal for food and farming for the EU-UK Summit on 20 November.
